text: __NOTOC__ The Skyfire Diamond is used by Alchemists to make the Alchemist Stone and by Jewelcrafters to make various cut gems.

Skullsplitter Tusk is a quest item only lootable by players on the quest Skullsplitter Tusks. Kebok in Booty Bay has been hiring adventurers to hunt Skullsplitter trolls for their tusks, which he then passes off as tiger fangs.

Sky Barges are huge dirigibles used by the Scourge to transport undead through the skies into battle or remote areas. They have a bat-like figurehead. They were seen in The Brothers Stormrage, Misconceptions and A Dark Covenant. Skybarge.JPG|Side view Reforged - Sky Barge concept.jpg|Warcraft III: Reforged concept art.

The Skychaser tribe is a tauren family and tribe whose members are the spiritual leaders of the tauren shamans. All of the Skychaser tribe that were living in Thunder Bluff were killed by members of the Grimtotem tribe following the death of Cairne Bloodhoof. The only known survivors are and , though other members that were away from Mulgore may still live as well. However, their shaman trainer NPCs in Thunder Bluff were not removed from the game with Cataclysm, but have been replaced by Cloudsong members in Patch 4.1.

Sky Darkener's Shroud of the Unholy is a quest reward from Tonight We Dine In Havenshire.

Sky-Captain "Dusty" Blastnut is the goblin Sky-Captain of the Horde zeppelin The Zephyr, which travels between the tauren capital of Thunder Bluff to the orc capital of Orgrimmar.

__NOTOC__ Sky-Reaver Korm Blackscar is an orc quest giver and the captain of the Horde gunship Orgrim's Hammer in Icecrown. During the assault on Icecrown he sent soldiers to ambush soldiers of the Alliance while they were battling the Scourge at the Broken Front; the conclusion of which resulted in all three sides taking major casualties. Though the Alliance were successfully robbed of their would-be stronghold in the region, Horde high command was outraged to learn of this cheap tactic. In particular, Warchief Thrall and Garrosh Hellscream did not approve of Blackscar's actions and summoned him to Warsong Hold. Garrosh angrily berates him for this act, and threatens to take his head for be
Skybreaker Shield-Mages are high elves aboard The Skybreaker in Icecrown. When The Skybreaker engages in battle with Orgrim's Hammer they cast shields around the ship for protection.
Skybreaker Cannoneers are level 80 humans and dwarves aboard The Skybreaker in Icecrown.
Skybreaker Deckhands are humans and dwarves aboard The Skybreaker in Icecrown.

__NOTOC__ Skybreaker Suppression Turret is a cannon attached to the Skybreaker Troop Transport in the Valley of Lost Hope of Icecrown.

Sky-Knight Handguards is a quest reward from Return to Aviana.
The Skullsplitter Speaker is a jungle troll found in Zul'Gurub.
Skyfury Staves is a weapon shop found in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. It was formerly located next to the Valley of Spirits.
Sky-Captain LaFontaine commands The Mighty Wind, the zeppelin that runs between Orgrimmar and Warsong Hold.
__NOTOC__ Skymane Bonobos are [monkey]]s on Jaguero Isle in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

The Skunkworks is a goblin encampment within the northern part of Silverwind Refuge. The camp is full of Goblin Technicians led by Chief Bombgineer Sploder, who keeps them working, yet not killing themselves. Sploder resides on a Super Reaper 6000, along with The Bomb, which is later shipped to Stonetalon by balloon. Foreman Jinx, a Horde quest giver, can be found here, but cannot be killed by Alliance players.

Sky Falls is a small area on the northwestern part of the Lost Peak on the Lost Isles. The entrance to the Gallywix Labor Mine is located here. Assistant Greely was able to help a few goblins escape the mines to this location, but was recaptured in the process.
Skylord Omnuron is night elf druid located in Mount Hyjal, alternate Draenor and the Dreamgrove. He is the leader of the Druids of the Talon at the Shrine of Aviana.
__NOTOC__ Skycaller Vrakthris is a centaur found in Thousand Needles.

The Sky Father is a deity worshiped by the tauren, seemingly as a counterpart to the Earth Mother. When a tauren is cremated, they are said to become one with both the Earth Mother and Sky Father; as the cremated's ashes fall to the earth while the smoke rises to the sky, the Earth Mother and Sky Father both welcome the honored dead.
Skybreaker Hierophants are night elves located in Icecrown Citadel.
Skybreaker Dreadblades are night elf and human death knights of the 7th Legion found aboard The Skybreaker during the Gunship Battle in Icecrown Citadel.
Skybreaker Marksmen appear during the Gunship Battle in Icecrown Citadel.
__NOTOC__ Skybreaker Protectors are draenei and dwarves who appear during the Gunship Battle in Icecrown Citadel.
Skybreaker Summoners are gnomes and humans who appear during the Gunship Battle in Icecrown Citadel. They are the Alliance analog of the Horde's Kor'kron Necrolytes.

The Skyfire was an Alliance gunship and navy flagship, which first saw action during the war against Deathwing. Since its first deployment against Deathwing himself in Dragonblight, the Skyfire served frequently in many of the Alliance's subsequent campaigns, including the offensive in Pandaria, the Siege of Orgrimmar, and the war in the Broken Isles. Its prestigious service and fierce reputation led it to become known as the pride of the Alliance fleet. Originally captained by Sky Captain Swayze, following the defeat of Deathwing the Skyfire was overhauled and placed under the command of Sky Admiral Rogers. The gunship would eventually be heavily damaged during a battle with the Horde's Win

__NOTOC__ Skyseeker Sailors are dwarves, humans, and night elves of Alliance crew of the Skyseeker gunship, found at the Wreck of the Skyseeker on the Wandering Isle, defending their camp against the Deepscale tribe. Some of them were injured.
Skybreaker Assassins are dwarves and gnomes located in Icecrown Citadel.
Skybreaker Luminaries are draenei located in Icecrown Citadel.
Skybreaker Sorcerers are gnomes located in Icecrown Citadel.
Skybreaker Vicars are human priests located in the Rampart of Skulls in Icecrown Citadel.
Skybreaker Vindicators are humans and dwarves found in Icecrown Citadel.
The Skyfire Medic's Staff is a quest reward from Unleash Hell.
__NOTOC__ Skyfire Gyrocopters are gyrocopters located in Jade Forest ridden by Strongarm Airmen as well as by Alliance adventurers during Unleash Hell.
Skyshards are used to create the Sky Crystal, which is used to break Alani's invincibility shield.
Sky Crystal is used to remove the cloudy protections of Alani the Stormborn.

Sky Master Corpora is an orc that can be found on the Hellscream's Fist in the Jade Forest. Although never stated, he's probably the captain of the airship. When the Hellscream's Fist is burning in the Jade Forest, he is heavily wounded, presumably hit by Alliance fire, lying unconscious and tended by Kor'kron Spisak. Since this is his only appearance, he probably died, either due to his wounds or when the airship crashed after being attacked by the Captain Doren.

Sky Marshal Schwind is a Forsaken located on the Hellscream's Fist in the Jade Forest. When the airship is burning after the first Alliance attack, Schwind can be found on the lower bridge speaking with Rivett Clutchpop. Since this is his only appearance, he probably went down with the ship not much time later.
Skumblade Scroungers are saurok located in Diremoor on the Isle of Thunder.
Skumblade Shortfangs are saurok located in Ihgaluk Crag on the Isle of Thunder.
Skumblade Fleshrippers are saurok located in Ihgaluk Crag on the Isle of Thunder.

The Skumblade tribe of saurok are led by the s, who promote the idea that the saurok were not created by the mogu, but instead were created by Kros, the invisible devilsaur in the sky. is held to be a gift from Kros and a glimpse at the Skumblade's future. Several members were taken as prisoners by Garrosh Hellscream and the True Horde.
Skyreach Crystal Clusters is provided by Zepik the Gorloc Hunter for Lightning Definitely Strikes Twice.

__NOTOC__ .]] The Sky Claw was a gnomish copter mount that appeared on the patch 5.2 PTR but was later removed at the last second due to unspecified issues. Later, it was announced that the mount would not be available in patch 5.3. Prior to the release of patch 5.3, it was indicated that a different Engineering mount was being considered due to ongoing problems with the Sky Claw. This later turned out to be the Sky Golem, which was released in patch 5.4.

Skybreaker Rifleman are dwarves located inside Icecrown Citadel.
Skybreaker Sergeants are humans located in Icecrown Citadel.

Skye Chandler is a Blizzard employee and Game Producer for Diablo III. She was also involved in production for the Ultimate Visual Guide, along with Joshua Horst and Leanne Huynh.

.]] Skysea Ridge is a small Druids of the Talon base in western Gorgrond. From here the druids have been surveying the steam geysers and keeping tabs on nearby Iron Horde troops like the one across the waters near Gorgorek's Fall.
Skyrider's Shining Shield is a random world drop from Pandaria mobs.

The Skulltaker was a member of the Laughing Skull Orcs living in Gorgrond until the day he placed The Silent Skull upon his head. This cursed mask drove him mad to the point of hunting down his own people instead of non-Laughing Skulls. He befriended the ravagers of Gorgrond and uses them to kill his people and travel undetected. Among these ravagers Gu'rakh appears to be his most trusted ally.

During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Skyhold was set aside by Keeper Odyn as the warrior order hall, granting the warrior the title of the Battlelord and commander of the Valarjar forces in the fight against the Burning Legion.

__NOTOC__ Sky Terrors are gargoyles attacking the Argent Stand in Zul'Drak. They circle above the battlefield but occasionally drop down, pick up an Argent Crusader or Argent Shieldman, lift them into the sky, and then drop them to their deaths. Commander Falstaav asks adventurers to hand out parachutes as a countermeasure.
Skyreach Stormcallers are arakkoa located in Spires of Arak.

Skyguard Marines are Alliance soldiers serving onboard the Skyguard gunship. They are the primary armed force present, and can be found on the main deck of the airship during battle. They were present during the Alliance's campaign on the Seething Shore to collect :Azerite, clashing with the Horde for the resource.

Skyguard Cannoneers are Alliance soldiers stationed on board the Skyguard gunship. They operate the numerous cannons of the airship, which has recently taken part in the campaign to retrieve the :Azerite resource from the Seething Shore. During the operation, the Skyguard would clash with Horde forces, and the cannoneers would unleash numerous broadsides on enemy gunships during the battle.

Skyguard Deckhands are Alliance sailors serving onboard the Skyguard gunship. They carry out manual labor around the vessel, and were present during its recent involvement in the battle at the Seething Shore with the Horde.
Skye is a ferret located in the Netley Inn in Stormsong Valley.
Skyfin are mana rays located in the Seat of the Triumvirate.
Skumblade Jeweled Cockroaches drop from Skumblade saurok at Ihgaluk Crag on the Isle of Thunder.
Skysec was a guardian of Nordrassil. During the Battle of Mount Hyjal, he endured endless waves of Scourge and Legion, and in the end proudly gave his life in defense of the World Tree.

Skyglaive Sentinels are night elves located in Kun-Lai Summit. They are part of Sarannha Skyglaive's forces.

Skyja was one of the Val'kyr who bound themselves to Sylvanas Windrunner. Following the end of the Fourth War, she followed her mistress after Sylvanas abandoned the Horde, where she eventually became the first of the Val'kyr to be transformed into a Mawsworn kyrian. She was present when Helya resurrected Annhylde in Desmotaeron in the Maw. From within the Sanctum of Domination, she and sisters stood together as the The Nine, where they were eventually confronted and killed by Azeroth's champions.
Skyja's Revenant Fury is dropped by The Nine in the Sanctum of Domination.
Skyreaver, Greataxe of the Keepers is dropped by Hylbrande in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Sky Legion Halbard is a world drop, dropping from mobs in Revendreth, Halls of Atonement, Castle Nathria, and Sanguine Depths.
Skyreach Dreadtalons are high arakkoa located in the Spires of Arak.
Skyreach Tempest-Keepers are high arakkoa located in the Spires of Arak.

Skyhold Claymore is sold by Quartermaster Durnolf in Skyhold for .

Skyscribe Stefen Edgley is a worgen located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

The Sky Hoard is a small, bone-filled but otherwise unoccupied cave on the northern face of the Aerie Chasm in west-central Forbidden Reach. Just to the east is the Featherfur Roost, and the Skyfox Den is across the chasm to the south.

Skyfox Den is a large cave on the southern face of the Aerie Chasm in west-central Forbidden Reach. Amberfur Alphas and Amberfur Slyvern use the cave as a den, but the rare Bonesifter Marwak is causing trouble with the bone piles.

Skyfury Headdress is created with Classic Leatherworking (300); taught by Ancient Pattern: Skyfury Headdress.

__NOTOC__ Sky-Captain Cableclamp commands The Purple Princess, the zeppelin that runs between Brill and Grom'gol Base Camp. A laid back captain, she allows most of her crew to relax when ever they can. She doesn't mind the guards sleeping while traveling, but when docked she expects them to at least try and look like they're doing their job. She usually only has a problem with Watcher Umjin, who tends to do nothing but sleep; she gave him the post as a favor to his family.
Sky-Captain Cloudkicker commands The Thundercaller, the zeppelin that runs between Orgrimmar and Brill. He never manages to get Chief Officer Coppernut's name or gender right.

Skywall, also known as Stormwall, is one of the four interlinked domains within the Elemental Plane. It was created eons ago by the titan-forged for the purpose of imprisoning most of Azeroth's air elementals.

Neeru Fireblade sends the player into Ragefire Chasm to slay Taragaman the Hungerer to deceive Thrall about the true leadership of the Searing Blade. The story is connected to the Hidden Enemies quest chain.

Slark is a rare mob murloc found patrolling the Longshore coast in Westfall with his buddy Brack. Slark is very fast moving, and catching him without any of his comrades is very hard. He is on a 1.5-2.5 hour respawn timer.

The Slave Master of the Blackrock clan led the raid on the settlement of Strahnbrad. He killed villagers Joe, Mike, and Scott by trampling them with his horse as Arthas entered the village. Arthas killed him as he was capturing villagers as slaves to sacrifice to the Burning Legion.

The Slag Pit lies deep within the Cauldron excavation site in Searing Gorge. It is run by cruel Dark Iron dwarves and worked by their slave laborers. Within the depths of the Slag Pit there is another danger, ravenous Incendosaurs. The Dark Irons are extremely hostile to any who would interfere with their mining operations. Note: although the slave laborers initially show up as yellow mobs, they will turn hostile if you attack a Dark Iron Slaver or Dark Iron Taskmaster within their aggro radius.
Slagtree's Lost Tools is located in the Vilebranch temples in the Hinterlands.

Like all online games, World of Warcraft has developed a rich, fairly cohesive glossary of slang terms to describe various items and events in the game. Some are specific to WoW, while others are shared with many other MMORPGs. If you wonder what a clothie, a healbot, or a meat shield is, or what someone is up to when they're using a sword and board, or what tanking and spanking something means, your best place to look is the game terms category. If it doesn't have them all, it certainly has most.
The Sleeping Gorge is a small chasm in eastern Deadwind Pass. One of the paths south to Karazhan runs through the gorge for a stretch before turning east into the Vice.
The Slave Pens are the first 5-man wing within the Coilfang Reservoir. The instance is harder than both the Blood Furnace and the Hellfire Ramparts, but the loot drops are of much greater quality.
Slavering Worgs could be found in Shadowfang Keep prior to the Cataclysm.

The Slaughter House is a bastion of the Scourge located in the deepest part of Stratholme, in Slaughter Square. The terrifying structure is home to the malevolent death knight Lord Aurius Rivendare and his minion, Ramstein the Gorger. It was once the home to Aurius's predecessor Baron Rivendare, and his hostage Ysida Harmon. Reaching the Slaughter House in 45 minutes from entering the Gauntlet allowed the players the chance to save Ysida from execution.
